status.description: completed = every page filled / every edit applied; partial = deck created or edited but some pages failed after retries; failed = nothing landed.

fileEntryId.description: File entry id of the deck, from slides_create / the edited file.

pages.description: Total page count of the deck.

outline.description: Final per-page titles of the deck.

warnings.description: Page-level tolerance warnings and failed pages worth reporting to the user.

summary.description: Concise outcome for the caller to relay: what was created/edited, failed pages and reasons, or why nothing landed.
